1) In case of any discrepancy in the above statement, please report within 30 day from the receipt of this statement.
2) This being computer generated statement, hence requires no signature.
3) Kindly register your contact details such as Email Id and Mobile Number with us so as to receive SMS / Email Alerts from Depositories CDSL /
NSDL in respect of your Demat Transactions, if not done. Also register your latest Bank details with us so as to receive cash corporate benefits on
your investment directly in your bank account.
4) There is a facility to avail Annual Report in Electronic form by submitting email id & opt for the same. You may register your email id in RTA /
Company records also by opting for the same. To avail these facilities, you are requested to contact your Branch.
5) Kindly note that Running Account Authorization given by you will be valid unless it is revoked by you. It can be revoked by sending a revocation
request letter at our registered office.
6) Kindly use MOFSL-NSDL pool CM BP ID - IN558336 for NSE pay-in and CM BP ID - IN652009 for BSE pay-in In case of any clarification please
contact your branch.
7) All clients having DP holding less than Rs. 2 lacs and who is holding only one account as first holder is eligible for BSDA scheme from every billing
cycle. To opt for BSDA please contact your branch.
8) We would like to inform that, in case of non receipt of Annual Maintenance Charge (AMC) w.r.t demat account, the dispatch of the physical
statement may be discontinued where the account continues to observes zero balance even after one year.

10) You will be receiving Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) in Electronic form from CDSL / NSDL, if you wish to receive CAS in Physical form or
do not wish to receive the same, kindly your servicing branch.
11) NSE & BSE has issued Circulars, cautioning the investors at large on unsolicited emails and SMS. In this reference you are requested to remain
cautious on the unsolicited emails and SMS advising to buy, sell or hold securities and trade only on the basis of informed decision. Investors are
advised to invest after conducting appropriate analysis of respective companies and not to blindly follow unfounded rumours, tips etc. Further, you are
also requested to share your knowledge or evidence of systemic wrongdoing, potential frauds or unethical behaviour through the anonymous portal
facility provided on Exchange website: http://www.nseindia.com/int_invest/dynacontent/any_portal.htm.
12) As per SEBI circular SEBI / LAD - NRO / GN / 2018 / 24 dated June 08,2018 for amendment to SEBI(LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND
DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) Regulations, from 5th December 2018 onwards physical shares transfer can only be done in case of death of the
holder or change of sequence of holder. Shares transfer to any other person will be done only through demat mode only.
13) For any DP related complaint please write to us at dpgrievances@motilaloswal.com, For complaint w.r.t. market manipulation/fraudulent activities,
you can write to NSDL on email id: report-mktmanipulation@nsdl.com, For broking related grievances write to grievances@motilaloswal.com.
